# Errors and exit codes

<!-- Generated by `bun run docs` from packages/contract/src/errors.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every ImStudium failure has one stable `code`. The CLI exits with the code's exit status; under `--json` it writes one error document to **stderr** (stdout stays empty). The MCP server returns the same document with `isError: true`.

```json
{ "error": { "code": "AUTH_REQUIRED", "message": "…", "hint": "Run: imstudium login", "retryable": false, "exitCode": 4, "status": 401 } }
```

- `status` is present when Stud.IP answered with an HTTP status.
- `retryable` is true when the same call may succeed later unchanged (network, HTTP 429/5xx).
- `details` carries machine-readable extras, e.g. `details.upstream.code` (Stud.IP's own error code) or `details.candidates` (`COURSE_AMBIGUOUS`).
- `legacyCode` names the pre-0.3 code when an old alias was thrown; it disappears in a later minor.

## Exit codes

| Exit | Category |
|---|---|
| 0 | success |
| 1 | internal |
| 2 | usage |
| 3 | gated (needs an explicit write or a person) |
| 4 | auth |
| 5 | not found |
| 6 | offline / network |
| 7 | Stud.IP error |
| 8 | workspace |

## Codes

| Code | Exit | Retryable | When | Default hint |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `UNKNOWN` | 1 | no | Unexpected failure (a bug, or something the CLI did not anticipate) | Run again with the same arguments; if it persists, open an issue with the command and the message |
| `UPDATE_FAILED` | 1 | no | `imstudium update` could not upgrade the global npm install | Run: npm i -g @imstudium/cli@latest |
| `BROWSER_LAUNCH_FAILED` | 1 | no | The sign-in browser (Playwright) could not start | Run: npx playwright install chromium |
| `CLI_NOT_FOUND` | 1 | no | The MCP server could not find the imstudium CLI to run | npm i -g @imstudium/cli, or set IMSTUDIUM_CLI to its path |
| `BAD_ARGS` | 2 | no | An argument or flag is missing, unknown or malformed | See: imstudium &lt;command&gt; --help |
| `NO_CLIENT_ID` | 2 | no | OAuth sign-in was requested without a client id | Set IMSTUDIUM_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID or oauth.clientId (docs/OAUTH.md), or run imstudium login without --oauth |
| `IDENTIFIER_UNRECOGNIZED` | 2 | no | The input is not a DOI, ISBN, arXiv id or web address | e.g. imstudium quellen add 10.1000/xyz123, an ISBN, arXiv:2101.01234 or a URL; without one use --manual |
| `IMPORT_FAILED` | 2 | no | The file could not be read as BibTeX/BibLaTeX, RIS or CSL-JSON | Export from Zotero, Citavi, Mendeley or JabRef as BibTeX (.bib), RIS (.ris) or CSL JSON (.json) |
| `WRITE_NOT_ALLOWED` | 3 | no | The call would change something in Stud.IP and was not explicitly allowed | Read-only by default: add --write in a terminal if you really mean it (never over MCP) |
| `AUTH_REQUIRED` | 4 | no | No usable Stud.IP session (signed out, expired or rejected) | Run: imstudium login |
| `SESSION_ORIGIN_MISMATCH` | 4 | no | The stored session belongs to another Stud.IP instance than the one requested | Run: imstudium login --instance &lt;url&gt; |
| `LOGIN_FAILED` | 4 | no | Browser sign-in did not produce a session | Run: imstudium login (or --manual) |
| `LOGIN_TIMEOUT` | 4 | no | Sign-in took too long | Run: imstudium login and finish the sign-in within a few minutes |
| `LOGIN_CANCELLED` | 4 | no | The sign-in window was closed before the login finished | Run: imstudium login |
| `LOGIN_INVALID_COOKIE` | 4 | no | The pasted or imported session cookie is not valid | Copy Seminar_Session again, or run: imstudium login |
| `CHROME_PROFILE_LOCKED` | 4 | no | --chrome-profile needs Chrome closed | Quit Chrome completely, then run: imstudium login --chrome-profile |
| `OAUTH_UNAVAILABLE` | 4 | no | OAuth is not available on this Stud.IP instance | Run: imstudium login (browser sign-in) |
| `OAUTH_CLIENT_INVALID` | 4 | no | Stud.IP rejected the OAuth client id | Check oauth.clientId in ~/.config/imstudium/config.json (docs/OAUTH.md) |
| `OAUTH_DENIED` | 4 | no | Access was denied on the Stud.IP consent page | Run: imstudium login --oauth and allow access |
| `OAUTH_TOKEN_FAILED` | 4 | yes | Exchanging the OAuth code for a token failed | Run: imstudium login --oauth |
| `OAUTH_REFRESH_FAILED` | 4 | no | Renewing the OAuth token failed | Run: imstudium login |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 5 | no | The thing you asked for does not exist (or you cannot see it) | Check the id or name; list commands show what exists |
| `COURSE_NOT_FOUND` | 5 | no | No course matches the name, shortcut or id | imstudium courses list shows your courses; pass a title fragment, slug or id |
| `COURSE_AMBIGUOUS` | 5 | no | Several courses match; the CLI will not guess | Pass a longer title fragment or the course id (see details.candidates) |
| `SEMESTER_NOT_FOUND` | 5 | no | No semester matches the label | imstudium semesters lists them, e.g. --semester "WS 2026/27" |
| `UNIT_NOT_FOUND` | 5 | no | No Courseware unit matches | imstudium courseware &lt;course&gt; lists the units |
| `PAGE_NOT_FOUND` | 5 | no | No wiki page matches | imstudium wiki &lt;course&gt; lists the pages |
| `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` | 5 | no | No JSON:API route matches the path | imstudium routes lists the routes of your Stud.IP |
| `ARBEIT_AMBIGUOUS` | 5 | no | Several Arbeiten (written works) exist and none is selected, or several match | Pass --arbeit &lt;slug&gt;, or run: imstudium arbeit use &lt;slug&gt; (see details.candidates) |
| `SOURCE_NOT_FOUND` | 5 | no | No source in the Arbeit's registry has this citekey | imstudium quellen lists the keys |
| `STYLE_NOT_FOUND` | 5 | no | No citation style (CSL) matches the id or file | imstudium stile lists the styles here; imstudium stile find &lt;words&gt; searches the CSL repository |
| `METADATA_NOT_FOUND` | 5 | no | doi.org, Crossref, the DNB or Open Library know no record for this identifier | Check the identifier for typos: a DOI doi.org does not know usually does not exist. Add a source without one with: imstudium quellen add --manual |
| `NETWORK` | 6 | yes | Stud.IP could not be reached (offline, DNS, timeout) | Check the connection; local commands (context, search, changes, today --offline) still work |
| `METADATA_UNAVAILABLE` | 6 | yes | A metadata service (doi.org, Crossref, DNB, Open Library, the CSL repository) could not be reached | Check the connection; imstudium quellen add --manual and every formatting command work offline |
| `UPSTREAM_ERROR` | 7 | no | Stud.IP answered with an error (details.upstream holds its code) | Retry later; if it persists the route may be disabled on your instance (imstudium routes) |
| `WORKSPACE_MISSING` | 8 | no | No Studium workspace here, or the course is not in it yet | Run: imstudium semester start (or imstudium sync) |
| `NO_CORPUS` | 8 | no | Nothing is extracted or indexed yet | Run: imstudium sync --extract (or imstudium extract) |
| `NO_ICS` | 8 | no | No calendar.ics in the workspace for --offline | Run: imstudium sync (writes calendar.ics), or pass --ics &lt;file&gt; |
| `ARBEIT_MISSING` | 8 | no | No Arbeit (written work) here: none matches, none in this folder, none in the workspace | Run: imstudium arbeit new "&lt;Titel&gt;" --typ hausarbeit |

## Legacy aliases

Older codes are mapped on the way out, so scripts written for 0.2 see the new code plus `legacyCode`.

| Old code | Now |
|---|---|
| `MISSING_ARG` | `BAD_ARGS` |
| `INVALID_KEY` | `BAD_ARGS` |
| `NO_SESSION` | `AUTH_REQUIRED` |
| `NOT_LOGGED_IN` | `AUTH_REQUIRED` |
| `SESSION_EXPIRED` | `AUTH_REQUIRED` |
| `NO_SEMESTER` | `SEMESTER_NOT_FOUND` |
| `NO_ROUTE` | `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` |
| `NO_ROUTES` | `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` |
| `HTTP_ERROR` | `UPSTREAM_ERROR` |
| `API_ERROR` | `UPSTREAM_ERROR` |
| `NO_WORKSPACE` | `WORKSPACE_MISSING` |
| `NO_COURSE_DIR` | `WORKSPACE_MISSING` |
| `NOT_IN_WORKSPACE` | `WORKSPACE_MISSING` |
